notes: Xep chat hon. File nhieu loai chi tiet (vd. 590.dwg) khong con bi dung som: loi raster duoc cap du thoi gian theo che do (590.dwg: 32 -> 31 tam). Loi raster tu thu xoay 90 va 45 do ben canh buoc xoay dat san va giu buoc tot hon: tren ho so that cua xuong tiet kiem 1-2 tam (13 -> 11, 10 -> 9).
